Question: Paula the painter and her two helpers each paint at constant, but different, rates. They always start at \(8{:}00\) AM and all three always take the same amount of time to eat lunch. On Monday the three of them painted \(50\%\) of a house, quitting at \(4{:}00\) PM. On Tuesday, when Paula wasn’t there, the two helpers painted only \(24\%\) of the house and quit at \(2{:}12\) PM. On Wednesday Paula worked by herself and finished the house by working until \(7{:}12\) PM. How long, in minutes, was each day’s lunch break?
